prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking, cinematic scene set in a surreal, steampunk-inspired world. The central subject is a young person with short, dark hair, dressed in a crisp white button-up shirt and high-waisted black trousers, standing in profile and reaching out with one hand toward a massive, ornate hourglass suspended in midair. The hourglass is filled with glowing blue sand, and its glass surface reflects the cool, ethereal light that bathes the entire scene. Surrounding the figure and hourglass are countless oversized, intricately detailed clockwork gears and cogs, some in sharp focus and others fading into a misty, dreamlike background. Chains and mechanical elements hang and twist throughout the composition, adding a sense of depth and complexity. The color palette is dominated by cool blues, silvers, and blacks, with luminous highlights that create a sense of otherworldly illumination. The lighting is dramatic, casting soft shadows and accentuating the reflective surfaces of the glass and metal. The overall style is highly detailed and polished, blending elements of anime and fantasy illustration with a touch of photorealism. The camera angle is slightly low, looking up at the subject and the towering hourglass, enhancing the sense of scale and wonder. The mood is contemplative and mysterious, evoking themes of time, destiny, and the passage of moments.
